== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1240_36</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 34E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-34E-There_Is_No_Try_Oppressive_Enforcement.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-thereisnotry&oppressiveenforcement-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), cover “official text as of April 27, 2013” ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]; original http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf, preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]), page 31. The Master List prints the icons; the image shows them as printed (Episode I, Dark Side Force, ▼, Immune to Alter).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Conference Room. Revolution is canceled. You may not deploy aliens (except bounty hunters and Mara Jade) or [Episode I] cards. Emperor and your admirals, generals, and moffs are Imperial Council Members and influence +1. While present here, each Imperial Council Member adds one [Dark Side Force]. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ one Laser Gate or a Political Effect. Your cards may deploy to table from Political Effects. May place your canceled Political Effect in Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_36</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 4 set mark, slip number 34E as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB4-34E-There_Is_No_Try_Oppressive_Enforcement-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B07 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
